subcategory_text: The development and testing environment(s) are separate from the production environment.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-15 (Development Process, Standards, and Tools), SC-7 (Boundary Protection)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.31 (Separation of development, test and production environments)
implementation_examples: Separate the development and testing environments from production to prevent leakage of personal data through non-production systems
Use sanitised data in non-production; if real data is essential, apply the same controls as production
Restrict production access from non-production identities
assessment_objectives: Determine whether development and testing environments are separated from production
Determine whether production data is sanitised or equally protected in non-production
Determine whether access controls enforce the separation
Determine whether boundary exceptions are reviewed
